_code: Paths that are gated until G0 is approved. Empty means builtin heuristics only (source extensions + manifests). Adding entries NARROWS the gate and takes effect immediately.
_always_allow: Paths exempt from the gate. Builtin exemptions (README, docs/**, **/*.md, .interlocking/**) are always unioned in and cannot be removed — planning must never be blockable. WIDENING this list has no effect until a human runs /il:policy.
_gate: enforce=false turns the G0 block into advisory notes. /il:doctor sets this automatically if the platform cannot support enforcement.
_override: Bounds on /il:override. It is both the escape hatch and the fast lane for typo-sized work.
_verify: Commands the verifier subagent is allowed to run. It has no other execution rights.
